# SRouter

> Product landing page for SRouter, a local-first AI gateway and LLM proxy.

## Product

- SRouter routes OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible requests through one local gateway.
- The local dashboard manages provider connections, virtual API keys, model routing, quotas, logs, and Cloudflare Tunnel state.
- Default gateway URL: http://localhost:3000
- API base URL: http://localhost:3000/v1

## Product areas

- [Product](https://srouter.web.id/#product): See the local gateway dashboard and product surfaces.
- [Control surface](https://srouter.web.id/#control-surface): Review routing, virtual keys, quotas, and traffic visibility.
- [Providers](https://srouter.web.id/#providers): See provider prefixes and authentication paths.
- [Run locally](https://srouter.web.id/#run-locally): Start SRouter with Docker.
- [FAQ](https://srouter.web.id/#faq): Read product and setup answers.
